changes: Added secure automatic update checks and a configurable update notification prompt.
Updates download from the EyEye release server, verify SHA-256, then replace the client JAR after Minecraft closes and shuts down.
Added Auto Librarian with villager and lectern selection, tradeable enchantment and level filters, automatic rerolling, pickup grace time and attempt logging.
Added a compact toggleable EyEye watermark module.
Replaced the Discord Rich Presence tagline with a stronger download-focused message.
Fixed Discord IPC pipe discovery on Windows so Rich Presence can connect reliably.
Added automatic Discord Rich Presence reconnection after Discord restarts.
Added EyEye Discord Rich Presence with server, world and main menu states.
Added spacing around the EyEye player mark in the tab list and enabled it in chat.
Rendered the EyEye logo directly beside detected client users in chat and tab.
Loaded the custom EyEye logo glyph texture into the client font system.
Fixed the custom EyEye logo glyph used for client identification.
Added the EyEye client logo beside users in chat and the multiplayer tab list.
Released the 1.8 branch with the latest module, branding and embedded Baritone improvements.
